---------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m6p5t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, Slots, MaxTTL

ASSUME MaxTTL \in Nat /\ MaxTTL >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    leased,       \* set of slots currently leased (eligible to seal)
    leaseHolder,  \* leaseHolder[s] = crane holding s's lease, or None
    sealed,       \* set of slots irreversibly sealed this voyage
    ttl           \* ttl[s] = remaining lease time on slot s

vars == << leased, leaseHolder, sealed, ttl >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leased \subseteq Slots
    /\ leaseHolder \in [Slots -> Cranes \cup {None}]
    /\ sealed \subseteq Slots
    /\ ttl \in [Slots -> 0..MaxTTL]

Init ==
    /\ leased = {}
    /\ leaseHolder = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ sealed = {}
    /\ ttl = [s \in Slots |-> 0]

\* A controller leases an unsealed, unleased slot to a crane.
Lease(c, s) ==
    /\ s \notin leased
    /\ s \notin sealed
    /\ leased' = leased \cup {s}
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![s] = c]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = MaxTTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED sealed

LeaseA(c, s) == Lease(c, s)
LeaseB(c, s) == Lease(c, s)

\* A crane with a live lease irreversibly seals its slot, consuming the lease.
Seal(s) ==
    /\ s \in leased
    /\ leaseHolder[s] # None
    /\ ttl[s] > 0
    /\ s \notin sealed
    /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {s}
    /\ leased' = leased \ {s}
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = 0]

\* A lease ticks down and clears on expiry.
Tick(s) ==
    /\ ttl[s] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1]
    /\ IF ttl[s] - 1 = 0
       THEN /\ leased' = leased \ {s}
            /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![s] = None]
       ELSE UNCHANGED << leased, leaseHolder >>
    /\ UNCHANGED sealed

\* Once the plan is sealed, a new voyage resets the yard.
NewVoyage ==
    /\ sealed # {}
    /\ leased' = {}
    /\ leaseHolder' = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ sealed' = {}
    /\ ttl' = [s \in Slots |-> 0]

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : LeaseA(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : LeaseB(c, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Seal(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Tick(s)
    \/ NewVoyage

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A sealed slot is never simultaneously leased: sealing happens at most once.
SealOnce ==
    \A s \in Slots : s \in sealed => s \notin leased

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxTTL = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SealOnce
nl:
Scenario: a container-ship crane yard sealing stow-slots under lease-based
ownership with expiry, where two yard controllers share one slot pool and sealing
is irreversible.

A crane takes a stow-slot on a lease with a time-to-live before it may seal it.
Sealing a slot is irreversible for the voyage: once sealed it stays sealed.
Sealing consumes the slot's lease. A slot can be leased only while it is unsealed,
so a sealed slot can never be re-leased and therefore never re-sealed. Two
independent yard controllers grant leases out of the same shared pool. A lease's
time-to-live counts down and on expiry the lease is cleared. When the whole plan is
sealed, a new voyage resets the yard, clearing seals and leases for the next ship.

Because sealing consumes a slot's lease and a sealed slot cannot be re-leased, a
sealed slot is never simultaneously leased -- so the irreversible sealing of any
slot happens at most once per voyage.

Actions: controller one leases an unsealed, unleased slot to a crane (LeaseA);
controller two leases an unsealed slot from the shared pool (LeaseB); a crane with
a live lease irreversibly seals its slot, consuming the lease (Seal); a lease ticks
down and clears on expiry (Tick); once the plan is sealed, a new voyage resets the
yard (NewVoyage).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a sealed stow-slot is never simultaneously leased, so the
irreversible sealing of any slot happens at most once per voyage.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m6p6t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines, Lines, MaxTTL

ASSUME MaxTTL \in Nat /\ MaxTTL >= 1

None == "none"
Instances == {"dispA", "dispB"}

VARIABLES
    leaseOwner,  \* leaseOwner[l] = machine holding line l's lease, or None
    ttl,         \* ttl[l] = remaining lease time on line l
    serving,     \* serving[l] = machine mid-serve on line l, or None
    granter      \* granter[l] = dispatcher that granted l's lease, or None

vars == << leaseOwner, ttl, serving, granter >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseOwner \in [Lines -> Machines \cup {None}]
    /\ ttl \in [Lines -> 0..MaxTTL]
    /\ serving \in [Lines -> Machines \cup {None}]
    /\ granter \in [Lines -> Instances \cup {None}]

Init ==
    /\ leaseOwner = [l \in Lines |-> None]
    /\ ttl = [l \in Lines |-> 0]
    /\ serving = [l \in Lines |-> None]
    /\ granter = [l \in Lines |-> None]

\* A dispatcher leases a free line to a machine, recording its grant.
Lease(inst, m, l) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[l] = None
    /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![l] = m]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![l] = MaxTTL]
    /\ granter' = [granter EXCEPT ![l] = inst]
    /\ UNCHANGED serving

LeaseA(m, l) == Lease("dispA", m, l)
LeaseB(m, l) == Lease("dispB", m, l)

\* A machine with a live lease begins serving its line.
Serve(m, l) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[l] = m
    /\ ttl[l] > 0
    /\ serving[l] = None
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![l] = m]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, ttl, granter >>

\* A serve completes.
FinishServe(l) ==
    /\ serving[l] # None
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![l] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, ttl, granter >>

\* A lease ticks down, and on expiry clears ownership and any serve in progress.
Tick(l) ==
    /\ ttl[l] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
    /\ IF ttl[l] - 1 = 0
       THEN /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![l] = None]
            /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![l] = None]
            /\ granter' = [granter EXCEPT ![l] = None]
       ELSE UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, serving, granter >>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines, l \in Lines : LeaseA(m, l)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, l \in Lines : LeaseB(m, l)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, l \in Lines : Serve(m, l)
    \/ \E l \in Lines : FinishServe(l)
    \/ \E l \in Lines : Tick(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A line with a serve in progress is owned by the serving machine under a live
\* lease, so no stale or unauthorized machine serves.
NoStaleServe ==
    \A l \in Lines :
        serving[l] # None => (leaseOwner[l] = serving[l] /\ ttl[l] > 0)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {m1, m2}
    Lines = {l1, l2}
    MaxTTL = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleServe
nl:
Scenario: a vending machine network using lease-based ownership of product lines
with expiry, where two dispatchers share one line pool.

Each product line is served under a lease that names one machine and carries a
time-to-live. Only the machine holding a live (non-expired) lease on a line may
serve a customer on it. A stale machine -- one whose lease has expired -- must
never have a serve in progress. When a lease expires, its ownership is cleared and
any serve in progress on that line is dropped, so no serve outlives its lease. Two
independent dispatchers grant leases out of the same shared pool of lines.

Because a machine serves a line only while holding a live lease on it, no
unauthorized or stale machine ever serves.

Actions: dispatcher one leases a free line to a machine, recording its grant
(LeaseA); dispatcher two leases a free line from the shared pool (LeaseB); a
machine with a live lease begins serving its line (Serve); a serve completes
(FinishServe); a lease ticks down, and on expiry clears ownership and any serve in
progress (Tick).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any line with a serve in progress is owned by the serving machine
under a live, non-expired lease.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m0p5t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, MaxVer

ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat /\ MaxVer >= 1

VARIABLES
    version,    \* conveyor version number
    entered,    \* entered[c] = TRUE iff car c is in the wash with an open read
    readVer,    \* readVer[c] = version car c read when it entered
    completed   \* set of cars whose wash is irreversibly completed

vars == << version, entered, readVer, completed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ entered \in [Cars -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ readVer \in [Cars -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ completed \subseteq Cars

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ entered = [c \in Cars |-> FALSE]
    /\ readVer = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ completed = {}

\* An operator enters an uncompleted car, taking an optimistic version read.
Enter(c) ==
    /\ ~entered[c]
    /\ c \notin completed
    /\ entered' = [entered EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, completed >>

EnterA(c) == Enter(c)
EnterB(c) == Enter(c)

\* A car with a current read irreversibly completes, clearing its entry.
Complete(c) ==
    /\ entered[c]
    /\ readVer[c] = version
    /\ c \notin completed
    /\ completed' = completed \cup {c}
    /\ entered' = [entered EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, readVer >>

\* A car with a stale read aborts to retry.
Abort(c) ==
    /\ entered[c]
    /\ readVer[c] # version
    /\ entered' = [entered EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, readVer, completed >>

\* The conveyor advances, bumping the version and staling entries in progress.
BumpVersion ==
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << entered, readVer, completed >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : EnterA(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : EnterB(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Complete(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Abort(c)
    \/ BumpVersion

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A completed car is never simultaneously entered: completion happens once.
CompleteOnce ==
    \A c \in Cars : c \in completed => ~entered[c]

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {car1, car2}
    MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CompleteOnce
nl:
Scenario: a car-wash conveyor line completing washes by optimistic locking with
retry, where two operators share one car pool and completing a wash is irreversible.

Completing a car's wash is irreversible: once completed it stays completed. The
conveyor carries a version number. A car enters the wash by taking an optimistic
read of the current version; it may complete only if the version has not advanced
since it entered -- if it has, the read is stale and the car aborts to retry.
Completing a wash clears the car's entry. A car may enter only while it is not
already completed, so a completed car can never re-enter and re-complete. Two
operators drive cars onto the same shared conveyor. Advancing the conveyor bumps
the version, staling entries in progress.

Because completing a wash clears the car's entry and a completed car cannot
re-enter, a completed car is never simultaneously entered -- so the irreversible
completion of any car's wash happens at most once.

Actions: operator one enters an uncompleted car, taking an optimistic version read
(EnterA); operator two enters an uncompleted car onto the shared conveyor
(EnterB); a car with a current read irreversibly completes, clearing its entry
(Complete); a car with a stale read aborts to retry (Abort); the conveyor advances,
bumping the version (BumpVersion).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a completed car is never simultaneously entered in the wash, so
the irreversible completion of any car's wash happens at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m1p6t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS N, Items, MaxRound

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 2
ASSUME MaxRound \in Nat /\ MaxRound >= 1

Heads == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(h) == (h + 1) % N

VARIABLES
    holder,    \* head holding the access token
    requests,  \* unordered pool of pending <<head, item>> dispense requests
    serving,   \* serving[h] = TRUE iff head h is mid-serve
    round      \* token round number (mod MaxRound+1)

vars == << holder, requests, serving, round >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Heads
    /\ requests \subseteq (Heads \X Items)
    /\ serving \in [Heads -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound

Init ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ serving = [h \in Heads |-> FALSE]
    /\ round = 0

\* A dispense request arrives into the unordered pool.
SendRequest(h, it) ==
    /\ << h, it >> \notin requests
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {<< h, it >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, serving, round >>

\* The token-holder begins serving a pending request for it.
Serve(h, it) ==
    /\ holder = h
    /\ << h, it >> \in requests
    /\ ~serving[h]
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![h] = TRUE]
    /\ requests' = requests \ {<< h, it >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round >>

\* A serving head finishes.
FinishServe(h) ==
    /\ serving[h]
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![h] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, requests, round >>

\* An idle holder passes the token to the next head, bumping the round.
PassToken ==
    /\ ~serving[holder]
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ round' = (round + 1) % (MaxRound + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << requests, serving >>

Next ==
    \/ \E h \in Heads, it \in Items : SendRequest(h, it)
    \/ \E h \in Heads, it \in Items : Serve(h, it)
    \/ \E h \in Heads : FinishServe(h)
    \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A head is mid-serve only while it holds the ring's single access token.
ServeNeedsToken ==
    \A h \in Heads : serving[h] => holder = h

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    Items = {cola, water}
    MaxRound = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ServeNeedsToken
nl:
Scenario: a pharmacy prescription dispenser network coordinated by a token ring
over a network that can reorder messages.

Dispensing heads are arranged in a ring sharing a single access token. Dispense
requests arrive from patients into an unordered request pool and may be serviced in
any order -- message order does not matter. A head may begin serving a request only
while it holds the ring's single access token; only the token-holder can act. Once
a head finishes serving and is idle, it passes the token to the next head in the
ring, bumping the round. The token is never passed while the holder is mid-serve.

Because a head serves only while it holds the single token, no unauthorized or
stale head -- one that does not currently hold the token -- can ever serve a
request.

Actions: a dispense request arrives into the unordered pool (SendRequest); the
token-holder begins serving a pending request for it, removing it from the pool
(Serve); a serving head finishes (FinishServe); an idle holder passes the token to
the next head, bumping the round (PassToken).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a dispensing head is mid-serve only while it currently holds the
ring's single access token.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m5p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, Groups, Quorum, MaxCap

ASSUME Quorum \in Nat /\ Quorum >= 1
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxCap >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    host,      \* the elected host group, or None
    proposal,  \* group currently proposed for host, or None
    voters,    \* players approving the current proposal
    inMatch,   \* inMatch[g] = TRUE iff group g is running a match
    capacity   \* arena capacity (changes at runtime)

vars == << host, proposal, voters, inMatch, capacity >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ host \in Groups \cup {None}
    /\ proposal \in Groups \cup {None}
    /\ voters \subseteq Players
    /\ inMatch \in [Groups -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ host = None
    /\ proposal = None
    /\ voters = {}
    /\ inMatch = [g \in Groups |-> FALSE]
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

\* Propose a group for the vacant host role.
Propose(g) ==
    /\ host = None
    /\ proposal = None
    /\ proposal' = g
    /\ UNCHANGED << host, voters, inMatch, capacity >>

\* A player approves the current proposal.
Vote(p) ==
    /\ proposal # None
    /\ p \notin voters
    /\ voters' = voters \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED << host, proposal, inMatch, capacity >>

\* Grant the host role to the proposed group once a quorum approves.
Grant ==
    /\ proposal # None
    /\ host = None
    /\ Cardinality(voters) >= Quorum
    /\ host' = proposal
    /\ proposal' = None
    /\ voters' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << inMatch, capacity >>

\* The host starts a match while the arena has capacity.
StartMatch(g) ==
    /\ host = g
    /\ capacity > 0
    /\ ~inMatch[g]
    /\ inMatch' = [inMatch EXCEPT ![g] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << host, proposal, voters, capacity >>

\* The host ends its match, releasing the host role.
EndMatch(g) ==
    /\ inMatch[g]
    /\ inMatch' = [inMatch EXCEPT ![g] = FALSE]
    /\ host' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, voters, capacity >>

\* The arena capacity changes at runtime.
CapacityChange(c) ==
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED << host, proposal, voters, inMatch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E g \in Groups : Propose(g)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Vote(p)
    \/ Grant
    \/ \E g \in Groups : StartMatch(g)
    \/ \E g \in Groups : EndMatch(g)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : CapacityChange(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A group runs a match only while it is the single elected host.
MatchNeedsHost ==
    \A g \in Groups : inMatch[g] => host = g

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {pl1, pl2}
    Groups = {g1, g2}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MatchNeedsHost
nl:
Scenario: a multiplayer game lobby matchmaker electing a match host by quorum vote,
where the arena capacity changes at runtime.

Player groups contend to host a match in the shared arena. Hosting is exclusive: at
most one group is the host at any time. A group becomes host only by quorum vote --
a proposal names a group, players approve it, and once a quorum of players has
approved, the host role is granted to the proposed group. Only the host may run a
match, and only while the arena has capacity. When a match ends the host role is
released. The arena capacity can change at runtime.

Because the host role names a single group and only the host may run a match, no
two groups ever run a match at the same time.

Actions: propose a group for the vacant host role (Propose); a player approves the
current proposal (Vote); grant the host role to the proposed group once a quorum
approves (Grant); the host starts a match while the arena has capacity
(StartMatch); the host ends its match, releasing the host role (EndMatch); the
arena capacity changes at runtime (CapacityChange).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a group runs a match only while it is the single elected host, so
no two groups ever run a match at once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m1p3t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS N, Slots, MaxRound

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 2
ASSUME MaxRound \in Nat /\ MaxRound >= 1

Feeders == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(f) == (f + 1) % N
None == N  \* numeric sentinel outside the feeder range

VARIABLES
    holder,   \* feeder holding the token
    owner,    \* owner[s] = feeder that owns slot s, or None
    claims,   \* unordered pool of pending <<feeder, slot>> requests
    holding,  \* holding[f] = set of slots feeder f has attached
    round     \* token round number (mod MaxRound+1)

vars == << holder, owner, claims, holding, round >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Feeders
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> 0..N]
    /\ claims \subseteq (Feeders \X Slots)
    /\ holding \in [Feeders -> SUBSET Slots]
    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound

Init ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ claims = {}
    /\ holding = [f \in Feeders |-> {}]
    /\ round = 0

\* A feeder drops an allocation request into the unordered pool.
Request(f, s) ==
    /\ << f, s >> \notin claims
    /\ claims' = claims \cup {<< f, s >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, owner, holding, round >>

\* The token-holder claims an unallocated slot it requested, recording ownership.
Claim(f, s) ==
    /\ holder = f
    /\ << f, s >> \in claims
    /\ owner[s] = None
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = f]
    /\ claims' = claims \ {<< f, s >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, holding, round >>

\* A feeder attaches a slot whose owner names it to its working set.
Attach(f, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = f
    /\ s \notin holding[f]
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![f] = @ \cup {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, owner, claims, round >>

\* A feeder releases a slot, clearing its owner.
Release(f, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = f
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![f] = @ \ {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, claims, round >>

\* The token passes to the next feeder, bumping the round.
PassToken ==
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ round' = (round + 1) % (MaxRound + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, claims, holding >>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, s \in Slots : Request(f, s)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, s \in Slots : Claim(f, s)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, s \in Slots : Attach(f, s)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, s \in Slots : Release(f, s)
    \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A feeder keeps a slot attached only while the slot's owner names that feeder.
AttachedImpliesOwner ==
    \A f \in Feeders, s \in Slots : s \in holding[f] => owner[s] = f

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 2
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxRound = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AttachedImpliesOwner
nl:
Scenario: a power-grid load shedder allocating shed-slots to feeders under a token
ring, over a network that can reorder messages.

Feeders are arranged in a ring sharing a single access token. Each shed-slot may be
allocated to at most one feeder. Feeders drop allocation requests into an unordered
pool that may be serviced in any order. Only the feeder currently holding the token
may claim a slot for itself, and only if the slot is unallocated -- claiming records
the slot's owner. A feeder attaches a slot to its working set only once the slot's
owner names it. Releasing a slot clears its owner. The token circulates around the
ring.

Because a slot's owner names a single feeder and a feeder attaches a slot only
while the owner names it, no shed-slot is ever allocated to two feeders at once.

Actions: a feeder drops an allocation request into the unordered pool (Request);
the token-holder claims an unallocated slot it requested, recording ownership
(Claim); a feeder attaches a slot whose owner names it to its working set (Attach);
a feeder releases a slot, clearing its owner (Release); the token passes to the next
feeder, bumping the round (PassToken).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a feeder keeps a shed-slot in its working set only while the slot's
owner names that feeder, so no slot is allocated to two feeders at once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m0p2t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total, MaxVer, MaxCap

ASSUME Total \in Nat /\ Total >= 1
ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat /\ MaxVer >= 1
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxCap >= 1

VARIABLES
    sterile,    \* units in the sterile store
    inUse,      \* units currently in use
    ver,        \* optimistic-lock version
    committing, \* TRUE iff a move transaction is in flight
    readVer,    \* version the in-flight transaction read
    capacity    \* current in-use capacity (changes at runtime)

vars == << sterile, inUse, ver, committing, readVer, capacity >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ sterile \in 0..Total
    /\ inUse \in 0..Total
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ committing \in BOOLEAN
    /\ readVer \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ sterile = Total
    /\ inUse = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ committing = FALSE
    /\ readVer = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

\* Begin a move by reading the current version.
BeginUse ==
    /\ ~committing
    /\ sterile > 0
    /\ inUse < capacity
    /\ committing' = TRUE
    /\ readVer' = ver
    /\ UNCHANGED << sterile, inUse, ver, capacity >>

\* Commit the move only if the read is still current.
CommitUse ==
    /\ committing
    /\ readVer = ver
    /\ sterile > 0
    /\ inUse < capacity
    /\ sterile' = sterile - 1
    /\ inUse' = inUse + 1
    /\ ver' = (ver + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << readVer, capacity >>

\* Abort a stale transaction to retry.
AbortStale ==
    /\ committing
    /\ readVer # ver
    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << sterile, inUse, ver, readVer, capacity >>

\* Return one in-use unit to the sterile store, bumping the version.
ReturnUnit ==
    /\ inUse > 0
    /\ inUse' = inUse - 1
    /\ sterile' = sterile + 1
    /\ ver' = (ver + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << committing, readVer, capacity >>

\* Change the in-use capacity, bumping the version and cancelling any transaction.
CapacityChange(c) ==
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c

    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << sterile, inUse, readVer >>

    \/ BeginUse
    \/ CommitUse
    \/ AbortStale
    \/ ReturnUnit
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : CapacityChange(c)

    MaxVer = 2

nl:
Scenario: a hospital operating-room scheduler moving sterile supply units by
optimistic locking, where the in-use capacity changes at runtime.

A fixed number of supply units is split between the sterile store and the in-use
set; units are only ever moved between the two, never created or destroyed. Moving a
unit into use is optimistic: a transaction reads the current version, and commits
only if the version has not moved since -- on commit it moves one unit from sterile
to in-use, provided the in-use count is below the current capacity, and bumps the
version. If the version moved first, the transaction aborts to retry. Units in use
can be returned to the sterile store, bumping the version. The in-use capacity can
change at runtime; a capacity change bumps the version and cancels any transaction
in flight.

Because every commit and return moves exactly one unit from one pool to the other,
the total unit count never changes.

in-use below capacity, bumping the version, only if the read is current (CommitUse);
abort a stale transaction to retry (AbortStale); return one in-use unit to sterile,
bumping the version (ReturnUnit); change the in-use capacity, bumping the version and
cancelling any transaction in flight (CapacityChange).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of supply units in sterile plus in-use always
equals the fixed starting count.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m6p6t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, Lobbies, MaxTTL

ASSUME MaxTTL \in Nat /\ MaxTTL >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    leaseOwner,  \* leaseOwner[lo] = host holding lobby lo's lease, or None
    ttl,         \* ttl[lo] = remaining lease time on lobby lo
    running,     \* running[lo] = host running lobby lo, or None
    slow         \* set of congested players

vars == << leaseOwner, ttl, running, slow >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseOwner \in [Lobbies -> Players \cup {None}]
    /\ ttl \in [Lobbies -> 0..MaxTTL]
    /\ running \in [Lobbies -> Players \cup {None}]
    /\ slow \subseteq Players

Init ==
    /\ leaseOwner = [lo \in Lobbies |-> None]
    /\ ttl = [lo \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ running = [lo \in Lobbies |-> None]
    /\ slow = {}

\* A non-congested player leases a free lobby, becoming its host.
Lease(p, lo) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[lo] = None
    /\ p \notin slow
    /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![lo] = p]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![lo] = MaxTTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED << running, slow >>

\* The host with a live lease begins running the lobby.
Run(p, lo) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[lo] = p
    /\ ttl[lo] > 0
    /\ running[lo] = None
    /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![lo] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, ttl, slow >>

\* A running session stops.
Stop(lo) ==
    /\ running[lo] # None
    /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![lo] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, ttl, slow >>

\* A lease ticks down, and on expiry clears ownership and any running session.
Tick(lo) ==
    /\ ttl[lo] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![lo] = @ - 1]
    /\ IF ttl[lo] - 1 = 0
       THEN /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![lo] = None]
            /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![lo] = None]
       ELSE UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, running >>
    /\ UNCHANGED slow

\* A non-congested host renews its live lease.
Renew(p, lo) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[lo] = p
    /\ ttl[lo] > 0
    /\ p \notin slow
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![lo] = MaxTTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, running, slow >>

\* A host becomes congested.
GoSlow(p) ==
    /\ p \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, ttl, running >>

\* A congested host recovers.
Resume(p) ==
    /\ p \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, ttl, running >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, lo \in Lobbies : Lease(p, lo)
    \/ \E p \in Players, lo \in Lobbies : Run(p, lo)
    \/ \E lo \in Lobbies : Stop(lo)
    \/ \E lo \in Lobbies : Tick(lo)
    \/ \E p \in Players, lo \in Lobbies : Renew(p, lo)
    \/ \E p \in Players : GoSlow(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Resume(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Any lobby being run is owned by the running host under a live lease.
NoStaleHost ==
    \A lo \in Lobbies :
        running[lo] # None => (leaseOwner[lo] = running[lo] /\ ttl[lo] > 0)

CONSTANTS
    Players = {pl1, pl2}
    Lobbies = {lo1, lo2}
    MaxTTL = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleHost
nl:
Scenario: a multiplayer game lobby matchmaker using lease-based ownership of
lobbies with expiry, where a host can be slow but never failed.

Each lobby is run under a lease that names one player as host and carries a
time-to-live. Only the host holding a live (non-expired) lease may run the lobby. A
stale host -- one whose lease has expired -- must never be running a lobby. When a
lease expires, its ownership and any running session on that lobby are cleared, so
no session outlives its lease.

A host may be SLOW: a congested host cannot take new leases or renew until it
recovers, but it has not failed and always eventually resumes. Congestion only
delays leasing and renewal; it never lets a stale host keep running.

Because a host runs a lobby only while holding a live lease on it, no unauthorized
or stale host ever runs a lobby.

Actions: a non-congested player leases a free lobby, becoming its host (Lease); the
host with a live lease begins running the lobby (Run); a running session stops
(Stop); a lease ticks down, and on expiry clears ownership and any running session
(Tick); a non-congested host renews its live lease (Renew); a host becomes congested
(GoSlow); a congested host recovers (Resume).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any lobby being run is owned by the running host under a live,
non-expired lease.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m0p1t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, MaxVal, MaxVer

ASSUME MaxVal \in Nat /\ MaxVal >= 1
ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat /\ MaxVer >= 1

VARIABLES
    tally,    \* shared stow-manifest tally
    version,  \* version tag of the tally
    reading,  \* reading[c] = TRUE iff crane c has an open read-modify-write
    readVal,  \* readVal[c] = tally c cached at its read
    readVer   \* readVer[c] = version c cached at its read

vars == << tally, version, reading, readVal, readVer >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ tally \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ reading \in [Cranes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ readVal \in [Cranes -> 0..MaxVal]
    /\ readVer \in [Cranes -> 0..MaxVer]

Init ==
    /\ tally = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ reading = [c \in Cranes |-> FALSE]
    /\ readVal = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ readVer = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]

\* A crane reads the tally and version into its cache, opening an update.
Read(c) ==
    /\ ~reading[c]
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ readVal' = [readVal EXCEPT ![c] = tally]
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED << tally, version >>

\* A crane commits only if its cached version is still current.
Write(c) ==
    /\ reading[c]
    /\ readVer[c] = version
    /\ tally' = (tally + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << readVal, readVer >>

\* A crane aborts a stale read to retry.
AbortStale(c) ==
    /\ reading[c]
    /\ readVer[c] # version
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << tally, version, readVal, readVer >>

\* Privileged override: the supervisor posts one update without the read handshake,
\* advancing the tally and bumping the version together.
AdminOverride ==
    /\ tally' = (tally + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << reading, readVal, readVer >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Read(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Write(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : AbortStale(c)
    \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A crane whose cached read is still current holds a cached tally matching the
\* live manifest, so no update is silently lost.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A c \in Cranes :
        (reading[c] /\ readVer[c] = version) => readVal[c] = tally

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    MaxVal = 2
    MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
Scenario: a container-ship crane yard updating one shared stow manifest by
optimistic locking, with a privileged admin override.

Cranes post updates to a shared manifest tally that carries a version number. A
crane runs a read-modify-write: it reads the current tally and version into a local
cache, then commits its update only if the version has not moved since -- a commit
advances the tally and bumps the version. If the version moved first, the read is
stale and the crane aborts to retry. Because a committing crane always bumps the
version, a crane whose cached read is still at the current version is guaranteed
that no update slipped in behind its back, so no update is silently lost.

There is a privileged admin override: the yard supervisor posts one update directly,
without the read handshake, advancing the tally and bumping the version together.
This makes every outstanding cached read stale so none can commit on top of the
override.

Actions: a crane reads the tally and version into its cache, opening an update
(Read); a crane commits, advancing the tally and version, only if its cached
version is still current (Write); a crane aborts a stale read to retry
(AbortStale); the supervisor posts one update directly, advancing the tally and
version together (AdminOverride).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any crane whose cached read is still at the current version holds a
cached tally equal to the live manifest, so no update is silently lost.

EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Operators, Stages, Cap, MaxWait

ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Cap >= 1
ASSUME MaxWait \in Nat /\ MaxWait >= 1

None == "none"
Slack == Cap + 2  \* type slack so the capacity bound is not typing-trivial

VARIABLES
    lineLock,   \* holder of the coarse line lock, or None
    stageLock,  \* stageLock[st] = holder of stage st's fine lock, or None
    occ,        \* occ[st] = cars in stage st
    waiting     \* cars in the shared waiting pool

vars == << lineLock, stageLock, occ, waiting >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ lineLock \in Operators \cup {None}
    /\ stageLock \in [Stages -> Operators \cup {None}]
    /\ occ \in [Stages -> 0..Slack]
    /\ waiting \in 0..MaxWait

Init ==
    /\ lineLock = None
    /\ stageLock = [st \in Stages |-> None]
    /\ occ = [st \in Stages |-> 0]
    /\ waiting = MaxWait

AcquireLine(op) ==
    /\ lineLock = None
    /\ lineLock' = op
    /\ UNCHANGED << stageLock, occ, waiting >>

AcquireStage(op, st) ==
    /\ lineLock = op
    /\ stageLock[st] = None
    /\ stageLock' = [stageLock EXCEPT ![st] = op]
    /\ UNCHANGED << lineLock, occ, waiting >>

\* The stage-lock holder loads a waiting car while the stage is below capacity.
LoadCar(op, st) ==
    /\ stageLock[st] = op
    /\ occ[st] < Cap
    /\ waiting > 0
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![st] = @ + 1]
    /\ waiting' = waiting - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << lineLock, stageLock >>

\* A car is removed from a non-empty stage back to the waiting pool.
RemoveCar(st) ==
    /\ occ[st] > 0
    /\ waiting < MaxWait
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![st] = @ - 1]
    /\ waiting' = waiting + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << lineLock, stageLock >>

ReleaseStage(op, st) ==
    /\ stageLock[st] = op
    /\ stageLock' = [stageLock EXCEPT ![st] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << lineLock, occ, waiting >>

ReleaseLine(op) ==
    /\ lineLock = op
    /\ \A st \in Stages : stageLock[st] # op
    /\ lineLock' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << stageLock, occ, waiting >>

Next ==
    \/ \E op \in Operators : AcquireLine(op)
    \/ \E op \in Operators, st \in Stages : AcquireStage(op, st)
    \/ \E op \in Operators, st \in Stages : LoadCar(op, st)
    \/ \E st \in Stages : RemoveCar(st)
    \/ \E op \in Operators, st \in Stages : ReleaseStage(op, st)
    \/ \E op \in Operators : ReleaseLine(op)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No conveyor stage ever holds more cars than its fixed capacity.
WithinCapacity ==
    \A st \in Stages : occ[st] <= Cap

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Operators = {op1, op2}
    Stages = {st1, st2}
    Cap = 2
    MaxWait = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
Scenario: a car-wash conveyor line using hierarchical locks (a coarse line lock,
then fine per-stage locks), where two operators share one pool of waiting cars.
Each conveyor stage has a fixed capacity.

Two operators feed cars onto the same conveyor from a shared pool of waiting cars.
To load a car into a stage an operator must take locks in hierarchical order: first
the single coarse line lock, then the fine lock on the specific stage. Only the
holder of a stage's lock may load a car into it, and only while the stage is below
its capacity. A car can be removed from a non-empty stage, returning to the waiting
pool. Fine stage locks are released before the coarse line lock.

Each stage has a hard capacity: a car is loaded only when the stage is strictly
below capacity, so no stage is ever overfilled no matter how the two operators
interleave.

Actions: grab the free line lock (AcquireLine); the line-lock holder locks a stage
(AcquireStage); the stage-lock holder loads a waiting car while below capacity
(LoadCar); a car is removed from a non-empty stage back to the pool (RemoveCar);
release a stage lock (ReleaseStage); release the line lock once holding no stage
locks (ReleaseLine).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no conveyor stage ever holds more cars than its fixed capacity.

CONSTANTS N, Rx, MaxRound

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 2
ASSUME MaxRound \in Nat /\ MaxRound >= 1

Dispensers == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(d) == (d + 1) % N

VARIABLES
    holder,    \* dispenser holding the token
    round,     \* token round number (mod MaxRound+1)
    filled,    \* set of prescriptions irreversibly filled
    fillable,  \* set of prescriptions currently authorized to fill
    crashed    \* set of dispensers that crashed (at most one)

vars == << holder, round, filled, fillable, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Dispensers
    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound
    /\ filled \subseteq Rx
    /\ fillable \subseteq Rx
    /\ crashed \subseteq Dispensers

Init ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ round = 0
    /\ filled = {}
    /\ fillable = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

\* Authorize an unfilled prescription, making it fillable.
Authorize(rx) ==
    /\ rx \notin fillable
    /\ rx \notin filled
    /\ fillable' = fillable \cup {rx}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, filled, crashed >>

\* The token-holder irreversibly fills a fillable prescription, consuming its auth.
Fill(d, rx) ==
    /\ holder = d
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ rx \in fillable
    /\ rx \notin filled
    /\ filled' = filled \cup {rx}
    /\ fillable' = fillable \ {rx}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, crashed >>

\* The token passes to the next dispenser, bumping the round.
PassToken ==
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ round' = (round + 1) % (MaxRound + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << filled, fillable, crashed >>

\* A single dispenser crashes silently.
Crash(d) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, filled, fillable >>

Next ==
    \/ \E rx \in Rx : Authorize(rx)
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers, rx \in Rx : Fill(d, rx)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers : Crash(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A filled prescription is never simultaneously fillable: filling happens once.
FillOnce ==
    \A rx \in Rx : rx \in filled => rx \notin fillable

    Rx = {rx1, rx2}
    MaxRound = 2

NEXT Next

nl:
Scenario: a pharmacy prescription dispenser network coordinated by a token ring,
where filling a controlled prescription is irreversible and a dispenser can crash
silently.

Dispensers are arranged in a ring sharing a single access token. Filling a
controlled prescription is irreversible: once filled it stays filled. Only the
dispenser currently holding the token may fill a prescription, and only one that is
currently fillable (authorized). Filling consumes the authorization, removing the
prescription from the fillable set. A prescription may be authorized only while it
is not already filled, so a filled prescription can never be re-authorized and
therefore never refilled. The token circulates around the ring.

A single dispenser may crash silently: it stops filling. The token still passes
past a crashed dispenser, and at most one dispenser ever crashes.

Because filling consumes the authorization and a filled prescription cannot be
re-authorized, a filled prescription is never simultaneously fillable -- so the
irreversible fill of any prescription happens at most once.

Actions: authorize an unfilled prescription, making it fillable (Authorize); the
token-holder irreversibly fills a fillable prescription, consuming its authorization
(Fill); the token passes to the next dispenser, bumping the round (PassToken); a
single dispenser crashes silently (Crash).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a filled prescription is never simultaneously fillable, so the
irreversible fill of any prescription happens at most once.

    granted,   \* drone granted the sector, or None

    \/ \E d \in Drones : Leave(d)

through a bounded work queue with backpressure, over a network that can reorder
messages.

enqueuing into a bounded work queue; the queue has a hard length bound, so a

survey is counted.

while it holds the grant, no two drones are ever in the critical sector at once.

(Enqueue); the dispatcher grants the sector to a request at any queue position,
removing it (Grant); the granted drone enters the sector (Enter); the occupant
leaves, releasing the grant and counting a survey (Leave).

sector grant, so no two drones are ever in the sector at once.

    sealable,  \* set of slots authorized to be sealed
    reqs,      \* unordered pool of pending <<crane, slot>> seal requests
    casReg     \* casReg[s] = compare-and-swap sequence register of slot s

    /\ sealable \subseteq Slots
    /\ reqs \subseteq (Cranes \X Slots)

    /\ sealable = {}
    /\ reqs = {}

Request(cr, s) ==
    /\ << cr, s >> \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {<< cr, s >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << sealed, sealable, casReg >>

\* An unsealed slot is made sealable (authorized).
Authorize(s) ==
    /\ s \notin sealable
    /\ s \notin sealed
    /\ sealable' = sealable \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED << sealed, reqs, casReg >>

    /\ s \in sealable
    /\ s \notin sealed

    /\ UNCHANGED << sealed, sealable, casReg >>

    \/ \E s \in Slots : Authorize(s)
    \/ \E cr \in Cranes, s \in Slots : Seal(cr, s)

ASSUME Quorum \in Nat /\ Quorum >= 1

VARIABLES
    proposal,   \* proposal[b] = robot proposed for bin b, or None
    tally,      \* tally[b] = approvals counted toward b's proposal
    owner,      \* owner[b] = robot that owns bin b, or None
    occupant,   \* occupant[b] = robot occupying bin b, or None
    msgs        \* unordered pool of pending <<voter, bin>> approvals

TypeOK ==
    /\ proposal \in [Bins -> Robots \cup {None}]
    /\ tally \in [Bins -> 0..Quorum]
    /\ owner \in [Bins -> Robots \cup {None}]
    /\ occupant \in [Bins -> Robots \cup {None}]
    /\ msgs \subseteq (Voters \X Bins)

Init ==
    /\ proposal = [b \in Bins |-> None]
    /\ tally = [b \in Bins |-> 0]
    /\ owner = [b \in Bins |-> None]
    /\ occupant = [b \in Bins |-> None]
    /\ msgs = {}

\* Name a robot for a free, unowned bin.
Propose(b, rob) ==
    /\ proposal[b] = None
    /\ owner[b] = None
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![b] = rob]
    /\ UNCHANGED << tally, owner, occupant, msgs >>

\* A voter sends an approval into the unordered pool.
SendApproval(v, b) ==
    /\ proposal[b] # None
    /\ << v, b >> \notin msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {<< v, b >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, tally, owner, occupant >>

\* An approval is counted, raising the bin's tally.
CountApproval(v, b) ==
    /\ << v, b >> \in msgs
    /\ tally[b] < Quorum
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {<< v, b >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, owner, occupant >>

\* The bin's ownership is granted once the tally reaches quorum.
Grant(b) ==
    /\ proposal[b] # None
    /\ owner[b] = None
    /\ tally[b] >= Quorum
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = proposal[b]]
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED << occupant, msgs >>

\* The named robot occupies the bin.
Occupy(b, rob) ==
    /\ owner[b] = rob
    /\ occupant[b] = None
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![b] = rob]
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, tally, owner, msgs >>

\* A bin is released, clearing its owner and occupant.
Release(b) ==
    /\ occupant[b] # None
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, tally, msgs >>

    \/ \E v \in Voters, b \in Bins : SendApproval(v, b)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, b \in Bins : CountApproval(v, b)
    \/ \E b \in Bins : Grant(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bins, rob \in Robots : Occupy(b, rob)
    \/ \E b \in Bins : Release(b)

\* A robot occupies a bin only while the bin's owner names that same robot.
OccupantOwnsBin ==
    \A b \in Bins : occupant[b] # None => owner[b] = occupant[b]

tally reaches the quorum, the bin's ownership is granted to the proposed robot and

names it; releasing a bin clears its owner and occupant.

owner names it, no bin is ever allocated to two robots at once.

into the unordered pool (SendApproval); an approval is counted, raising the bin's

owner and occupant (Release).

same robot, so no bin is ever allocated to two robots at once.

    /\ UNCHANGED << inStation, capacity >>

\* The lock-holder releases the lock once out of the station.

    /\ ~inStation[t]
    /\ lockReg' = None
    /\ casSeq' = (casSeq + 1) % (MaxSeq + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << inStation, capacity >>

\* The station capacity changes at runtime.
CapacityChange(c) ==
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED << lockReg, inStation, casSeq >>

Next ==

    \/ \E t \in Techs : Enter(t)
    \/ \E t \in Techs : Leave(t)
    \/ \E t \in Techs : Release(t)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : CapacityChange(c)

\* A technician is in the station only while it holds the single lock register.

compare-and-swap lock register, where the station capacity changes at runtime.

lock register: a technician acquires the lock only while it is free (a successful
compare-and-swap that bumps the register's sequence), giving it exclusive right to
enter the station. A technician may enter the station only while it holds the lock,
and only while the station has capacity; on leaving it stays lock-holder until it
releases the lock. The station capacity can change at runtime.

station only while it holds the lock, no two technicians are ever in the
cross-match station at once.

sequence (Acquire); the lock-holder enters the station while it has capacity
(Enter); the occupant leaves the station (Leave); the lock-holder releases the lock
once out of the station, bumping the sequence (Release); the station capacity
changes at runtime (CapacityChange).

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m2p1t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS MaxVer, MaxVal

ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat /\ MaxVer >= 1
ASSUME MaxVal \in Nat /\ MaxVal >= 1

VARIABLES
    version,    \* version tag of the lock configuration
    config,     \* the shared lock configuration value
    committing, \* TRUE iff an update is staged for commit
    stagedVer   \* version the staged update was computed against

vars == << version, config, committing, stagedVer >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ config \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ committing \in BOOLEAN
    /\ stagedVer \in 0..MaxVer

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ config = 0
    /\ committing = FALSE
    /\ stagedVer = 0

\* Stage a new configuration computed against the current version.
Prepare ==
    /\ ~committing
    /\ committing' = TRUE
    /\ stagedVer' = version
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, config >>

\* Commit the staged configuration only if still based on the current version.
Commit ==
    /\ committing
    /\ stagedVer = version
    /\ config' = (config + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED stagedVer

\* Roll back a staged configuration before commit.
Rollback ==
    /\ committing
    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, config, stagedVer >>

\* Privileged override: post one update directly, advancing configuration and
\* version together and cancelling any staged update in flight.
AdminOverride ==
    /\ config' = (config + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED stagedVer

Next ==
    \/ Prepare
    \/ Commit
    \/ Rollback
    \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A staged update is always based on the configuration's current version.
NoStaleCommit ==
    committing => stagedVer = version

CONSTANTS
    MaxVer = 2
    MaxVal = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleCommit
nl:
Scenario: a smart-home door-lock network updating one shared lock configuration by
two-phase commit, with a privileged admin override.

A shared lock configuration is tagged with a version number. Updating it uses two
phases: a prepare phase stages a new configuration computed against the current
version, and a commit phase applies the staged value only if the version has not
moved since staging, advancing both the configuration and its version. A staged
update may also be rolled back before commit.

There is a privileged admin override: the homeowner posts one configuration update
directly, without the two-phase handshake, advancing the configuration and version
together and cancelling any staged update in flight -- so a staged update computed
against the old version can never be committed on top of the override.

Because a staged update is committed only while it is still based on the current
version, no update is ever applied on top of a stale version and lost.

Actions: stage a new configuration against the current version (Prepare); commit the
staged configuration, advancing it and the version, only if still current (Commit);
roll back a staged configuration (Rollback); the homeowner posts one update directly,
advancing configuration and version together and cancelling any staged update
(AdminOverride).

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever an update is staged for commit, its staged version equals
the configuration's current version, so no update is committed on top of a stale
version.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m9p3t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Copies, Patrons, MaxEpoch, MaxCap

ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch >= 1
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxCap >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    owner,       \* owner[cp] = patron that owns copy cp, or None
    ownerEpoch,  \* ownerEpoch[cp] = epoch cp was allocated at
    occupant,    \* occupant[cp] = patron who checked out cp, or None
    epoch,       \* current catalog epoch
    capacity     \* current loan capacity (changes at runtime)

vars == << owner, ownerEpoch, occupant, epoch, capacity >>

Owned == {cp \in Copies : owner[cp] # None}

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Copies -> Patrons \cup {None}]
    /\ ownerEpoch \in [Copies -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ occupant \in [Copies -> Patrons \cup {None}]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ owner = [cp \in Copies |-> None]
    /\ ownerEpoch = [cp \in Copies |-> 0]
    /\ occupant = [cp \in Copies |-> None]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

\* Allocate a free copy to a patron below capacity, stamping the current epoch.
Allocate(p, cp) ==
    /\ owner[cp] = None
    /\ Cardinality(Owned) < capacity
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![cp] = p]
    /\ ownerEpoch' = [ownerEpoch EXCEPT ![cp] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED << occupant, epoch, capacity >>

\* A patron occupies a copy whose owner names it under the current epoch.
Occupy(p, cp) ==
    /\ owner[cp] = p
    /\ ownerEpoch[cp] = epoch
    /\ occupant[cp] = None
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![cp] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, ownerEpoch, epoch, capacity >>

\* Reconfigure the catalog, bumping the epoch.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch' = (epoch + 1) % (MaxEpoch + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, ownerEpoch, occupant, capacity >>

\* Release a copy, clearing its owner and occupant.
Release(cp) ==
    /\ occupant[cp] # None
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![cp] = None]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![cp] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ownerEpoch, epoch, capacity >>

\* Change the loan capacity at runtime.
CapacityChange(c) ==
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, ownerEpoch, occupant, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, cp \in Copies : Allocate(p, cp)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, cp \in Copies : Occupy(p, cp)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E cp \in Copies : Release(cp)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : CapacityChange(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A patron occupies a copy only while the copy's owner names that same patron.
OccupantOwnsCopy ==
    \A cp \in Copies : occupant[cp] # None => owner[cp] = occupant[cp]

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Copies = {cp1, cp2}
    Patrons = {p1, p2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OccupantOwnsCopy
nl:
Scenario: a library book reservation system allocating copies under epoch-numbered
reconfiguration, where the loan capacity changes at runtime.

Each copy may be allocated to at most one patron. An allocation records the patron
as the copy's owner, stamped with the current catalog epoch, and is capacity-bounded:
a copy is allocated only while the number of allocated copies is below the current
loan capacity. A patron occupies (checks out) a copy only once the copy's owner names
it and the allocation carries the current epoch. The catalog is reconfigured from time
to time, bumping the epoch, which makes older allocations un-occupiable until they are
released and re-allocated. The loan capacity can change at runtime. Releasing a copy
clears its owner and occupant.

Because a copy's owner names a single patron and a patron occupies a copy only while
the owner names it, no copy is ever allocated to two patrons at once.

Actions: allocate a free copy to a patron below capacity, stamping the current epoch
(Allocate); a patron occupies a copy whose owner names it under the current epoch
(Occupy); reconfigure the catalog, bumping the epoch (Reconfigure); release a copy,
clearing its owner and occupant (Release); change the loan capacity at runtime
(CapacityChange).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a patron occupies a copy only while the copy's owner names that same
patron, so no copy is ever allocated to two patrons at once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m3p1t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Drones, MaxTerm, MaxVal

ASSUME MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxTerm >= 1
ASSUME MaxVal \in Nat /\ MaxVal >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    leader,     \* the elected leader drone, or None
    term,       \* current leadership term (mod MaxTerm+1)
    mapVal,     \* the shared surveillance map value
    writing,    \* TRUE iff the leader has an open map write
    writeTerm,  \* term the open write was stamped with
    crashed     \* set of drones that crashed (at most one)

vars == << leader, term, mapVal, writing, writeTerm, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Drones \cup {None}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ mapVal \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ writing \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writeTerm \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ crashed \subseteq Drones

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0
    /\ mapVal = 0
    /\ writing = FALSE
    /\ writeTerm = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

\* Elect a live drone leader for a fresh term while leadership is vacant.
Elect(d) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ leader' = d
    /\ term' = (term + 1) % (MaxTerm + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << mapVal, writing, writeTerm, crashed >>

\* The leader opens a write stamped with the current term.
BeginWrite(d) ==
    /\ leader = d
    /\ ~writing
    /\ writing' = TRUE
    /\ writeTerm' = term
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, mapVal, crashed >>

\* The leader commits its write, advancing the map, only while its term is current.
CommitWrite(d) ==
    /\ leader = d
    /\ writing
    /\ writeTerm = term
    /\ mapVal' = (mapVal + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)
    /\ writing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, writeTerm, crashed >>

\* The leader steps down, cancelling any open write.
FailLeader(d) ==
    /\ leader = d
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ writing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << term, mapVal, writeTerm, crashed >>

\* A single drone crashes silently, vacating leadership and cancelling its write.
Crash(d) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {d}
    /\ leader' = IF leader = d THEN None ELSE leader
    /\ writing' = IF leader = d THEN FALSE ELSE writing
    /\ UNCHANGED << term, mapVal, writeTerm >>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Elect(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : BeginWrite(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CommitWrite(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : FailLeader(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Crash(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Any open map write is stamped with the current leadership term, so a write
\* opened under a deposed leader never commits and no update is lost.
NoStaleWrite ==
    writing => writeTerm = term

=============================================================================

    Drones = {dr1, dr2}
    MaxTerm = 2
    MaxVal = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleWrite
nl:
Scenario: a wildfire drone surveillance swarm updating one shared surveillance map
under leader election with failover, where a single drone can crash silently.

Only the elected leader may update the shared map, and it does so in two steps: it
opens a write stamped with the current leadership term, then commits it -- advancing
the map -- but only while the write's term still matches the current term. Leadership
fails over: the leader may step down or crash, vacating leadership and cancelling any
open write, and a new leader is then elected for a fresh term. Because an open write
is cancelled when leadership changes, a write opened under a deposed leader can never
commit under a new leader, so a stale leader can never overwrite and lose the new
leader's updates.

A single drone may crash silently: it stops participating; if it was the leader,
leadership is vacated and its open write cancelled. At most one drone ever crashes.

Actions: elect a live drone leader for a fresh term while leadership is vacant
(Elect); the leader opens a write stamped with the current term (BeginWrite); the
leader commits its write, advancing the map, only while the write's term is current
(CommitWrite); the leader steps down, cancelling any open write (FailLeader); a
single drone crashes silently, vacating leadership and cancelling its write if it was
the leader (Crash).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any open map write is stamped with the current leadership term, so a
write opened under a deposed leader never commits and no committed update is lost.
